output.title: Can't tell if ACME account key Secrets are created here
output.content: The release notes say cert-manager v1.18.0 adds the label `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: cert-manager` to the Let's Encrypt account keys it creates. Nothing in the environment summary shows Let's Encrypt being used: the only resources listed are `cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate` and `apps/v1 Deployment`, the only installed CRD is `certificates.cert-manager.io`, and none of the values keys mention ACME or Let's Encrypt. We also don't know which issuer your Certificates point to, so we can't say whether cert-manager creates account key Secrets in this cluster. To settle this, check whether you use a Let's Encrypt issuer, and whether anything that selects or watches Secrets by the `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by` label would now start matching those account key Secrets.
